skills.label: communication, collaboration and creativity
skills.description: Communicating, collaborating, liaising, and negotiating with other people, developing solutions to problems, creating plans or specifications for the design of objects and systems, composing text or music, performing to entertain an audience, and imparting knowledge to others.

skills.label: negotiating
skills.description: Exchanging ideas while analysing issues and interests at stake, enabling opposing sides to resolve disputes and reach agreement, or making decisions to resolve disputes or impose justice.

skills.label: liaising and networking
skills.description: Developing alliances, contacts or partnerships, and exchanging information with others.

skills.label: teaching and training
skills.description: Facilitating the acquisition of new knowledge and skills. Leading and guiding individuals and groups through a process in which they are taught the necessary skills and knowledge for life, future learning or for a particular job or set of jobs.

skills.label: presenting information
skills.description: Presenting oral or visual material to an audience in order to provide or interpret information.

skills.label: advising and consulting
skills.description: Providing guidance and advice to enable decision-making about tasks, situations, and processes.

skills.label: promoting, selling and purchasing
skills.description: Using communication strategies or techniques to encourage acceptance of goods, services, or ideas, and to sell or buy and goods or services.

skills.label: obtaining information verbally
skills.description: Asking questions and listening to others to obtain information.

skills.label: working with others
skills.description: Working with other people, understanding and respecting the roles and competencies of others.

skills.label: solving problems
skills.description: Developing and implementing solutions to practical, operational or conceptual problems which arise in the execution of work in a wide range of contexts.

skills.label: designing systems and products
skills.description: Creating a plan or specification for the construction of an object, system or structure based on aesthetic and/or functional design concepts.

skills.label: creating artistic, visual or instructive materials
skills.description: Creating and developing visual representations and displays, instructional or promotional materials, or artistic designs or performances.

skills.label: writing and composing
skills.description: Writing text or composing music, creating original work with regard to format, style and content.

skills.label: performing and entertaining
skills.description: Undertaking activities to entertain an audience or improve personal abilities.

skills.label: using more than one language
skills.description: Using more than one language or dialect to communicate verbally or in written form, or to translate from one language to another.

skills.label: information skills
skills.description: Collecting, storing, monitoring, and using information; Conducting studies, investigations and tests; maintaining records; managing, evaluating, processing, analysing and monitoring information and projecting outcomes.

skills.label: conducting studies, investigations and examinations
skills.description: Conducting studies, investigations, and examinations to increase knowledge and understanding, diagnose problems or identify needs and requirements.

skills.label: documenting and recording information
skills.description: Maintaining records of information, transactions and activities in digital, paper or other forms.

skills.label: managing information
skills.description: Setting up and managing manual or electronic systems for storing , selecting, organizing, retrieving, distributing and safeguarding information.

skills.label: processing information
skills.description: Inputting, recording, transcribing and updating data using electronic or manual information systems.

skills.label: measuring physical properties
skills.description: Measuring the dimensions, weight, density and other physical properties of objects, materials and spaces.

skills.label: calculating and estimating
skills.description: Performing mathematical calculations and estimating the results of an action or a series of actions.

skills.label: analysing and evaluating information and data
skills.description: Examining data or facts to determine appropriate actions or recommendations; comparing and critically evaluating the credibility and reliability of sources of data; making and defending judgements based on internal evidence and external criteria.

skills.label: monitoring, inspecting and testing
skills.description: Examining and investigating problems, sites or objects to assess functioning or compliance with standards, laws or regulations.

skills.label: monitoring developments in area of expertise
skills.description: Monitoring and keeping knowledge up-to-date concerning new research, methodologies, regulations, policies technological developments and other significant changes relevant to a particular field of specialisation.

skills.label: assisting and caring
skills.description: Providing assistance, nurturing, care, service and support to people, and ensuring compliance to rules, standards, guidelines or laws.

skills.label: counselling
skills.description: Responding to clients' needs by interpreting their emotional and motivational states, and determining and providing appropriate support or interventions.

skills.label: providing health care or medical treatments
skills.description: Treating injuries and health conditions through the provision of health care and medical treatments to people.

skills.label: protecting and enforcing
skills.description: Responding to public and personal safety and security needs and ensuring compliance to rules, standards, guidelines or laws.

skills.label: providing information and support to the public and clients
skills.description: Assisting the public by answering questions, making recommendations, and providing information or support in response to requests.

skills.label: preparing and serving food and drinks
skills.description: Providing food and beverage services.

skills.label: providing general personal care
skills.description: Responding to the daily and occasional personal care needs of people.

skills.label: management skills
skills.description: Managing people, activities, resources, and organisation; developing objectives and strategies, organising work activities, allocating and controlling resources and leading, motivating, recruiting and supervising people and teams.

skills.label: developing objectives and strategies
skills.description: Envisioning a future state and developing strategies, goals, objectives and action plans to achieve it.

skills.label: organising, planning and scheduling work and activities
skills.description: Directing activities and tasks, establishing schedules and co-ordinating the activities of groups and individuals to complete objectives on time and within budget.

skills.label: allocating and controlling resources
skills.description: Determining the distribution and availability of people, assets, materials or capital to accomplish organizational goals and putting in place financial and administrative controls.

skills.label: performing administrative activities
skills.description: Performing administrative tasks such as typing up reports, ordering supplies, maintaining mail correspondence, and ensuring administrative systems, processes and databases are efficient.

skills.label: leading and motivating
skills.description: Reinforcing an organization's vision, inspiring and enthusing others to achieve positive outcomes. The focus of this group is on skills in motivating and inspiring others, rather than on managing and supervising a team.

skills.label: building and developing teams
skills.description: Encouraging team members and building a relationship of mutual trust, respect and cooperation. Stimulating teambuilding activities.

skills.label: recruiting and hiring
skills.description: Acquiring the right talent to achieve the organization's mission.

skills.label: supervising people
skills.description: Assigning responsibilities to others and directing and monitoring their performance.

skills.label: making decisions
skills.description: Making a choice from several alternative possibilities.

skills.label: working with computers
skills.description: Using computers and other digital tools to develop, install and maintain ICT software and infrastructure and to browse, search, filter, organise, store, retrieve, and analyse data, to collaborate and communicate with others, to create and edit new content.

skills.label: programming computer systems
skills.description: Writing and submitting instructions, specifications and programmes for computers.

skills.label: setting up and protecting computer systems
skills.description: Setting up, protecting and resolving problems with computer systems, networks, or similar information systems.

skills.label: accessing and analysing digital data
skills.description: Using digital tools to browse, search, filter, organise, store, retrieve, and analyse data, information and digital content, to collaborate and communicate with others, and create and edit new content.

skills.label: using digital tools for collaboration, content creation and problem solving
skills.description: Using ICT software and hardware to collaborate and communicate with others, creating and editing new content (from word processing to images and video) and solving conceptual, technical and practical problems.

skills.label: using digital tools to control machinery
skills.description: Issuing commands to computer controlled machines and equipment by despatching the appropriate data and input.

skills.label: handling and moving
skills.description: Sorting, arranging, moving, transforming, fabricating and cleaning goods and materials by hand or using handheld tools and equipment. Tending plants, crops and animals.

skills.label: sorting and packaging goods and materials
skills.description: Sorting, packaging, separating or arranging materials, according to established patterns or procedures.

skills.label: moving and lifting
skills.description: Performing physical activities to move, load, unload or store objects, position workpieces or equipment for assembly, or to climb structures, by hand or with the aid of equipment.

skills.label: transforming and blending materials
skills.description: Transforming materials from one form to another by mixing, blending, heating or chemical reaction, by hand or using handheld tools and equipment.

skills.label: tending plants and crops
skills.description: Propagating, cultivating, pruning, caring for and harvesting plants and crops.

skills.label: assembling and fabricating products
skills.description: Fabricating, assembling or repairing products or work aids by hand, or using hand-held tools and equipment.

skills.label: making moulds, casts, models and patterns
skills.description: Making moulds, casts and two-dimensional patterns or templates and making three-dimensional models of products.

skills.label: using hand tools
skills.description: Using the hands and tools that can be held in the hands, including power tools.

skills.label: handling animals
skills.description: Handling, moving, feeding and caring for live animals.

skills.label: cleaning
skills.description: Cleaning buildings, work areas, equipment, machinery and vehicles.

skills.label: washing and maintaining textiles and clothing
skills.description: Washing or cleaning clothing and other textile products by hand or using a washing or laundry machine, maintaining textile items in good order.

skills.label: handling and disposing of waste and hazardous materials
skills.description: Collecting, storing and disposing of unwanted materials or hazardous, according to established waste management procedures.

skills.label: constructing
skills.description: Building, repairing, installing and finishing interior and exterior structures.

skills.label: building and repairing structures
skills.description: Forming, shaping and joining materials to form structures such as buildings, bridges, or underground mines according to specifications and plans.

skills.label: installing interior or exterior infrastructure
skills.description: Installing, repairing and testing systems and their components in buildings and other structures such as trains and aircraft.

skills.label: finishing interior or exterior of structures
skills.description: Applying interior and exterior finishes to buildings and other structures.

skills.label: working with machinery and specialised equipment
skills.description: Controlling, operating and monitoring vehicles, stationary and mobile machinery and precision instrumentation and equipment.

skills.label: operating mobile plant
skills.description: Controlling the operation of machinery whose mobility is an integral part of its function, such as earthmoving, agricultural, forestry and lifting equipment.

skills.label: driving vehicles
skills.description: Driving vehicles on or off road, such as motorcycles, cars, vans, trucks and buses, for the transportation of goods or people by road.

skills.label: operating watercraft
skills.description: Operating and controlling the movement of watercraft and underwater vessels, including ships, boats and other types of vessel.

skills.label: operating machinery for the extraction and processing of raw materials
skills.description: Operating and monitoring various types of mechanically-controlled or computer-controlled stationary machinery for the extraction or processing of raw materials.

skills.label: operating machinery for the manufacture of products
skills.description: Operating and monitoring various types of mechanically-controlled or computer-controlled stationary machinery for the manufacture of goods.

skills.label: using precision instrumentation and equipment
skills.description: Controlling, monitoring, and adjusting precision instrumentation and equipment for a wide range of purposes.

skills.label: installing, maintaining and repairing mechanical equipment
skills.description: Installing, maintaining and repairing stationary and mobile mechanical equipment, components and devices.

skills.label: installing, maintaining and repairing electrical, electronic and precision equipment
skills.description: Installing, setting-up, maintaining and repairing electrical and electronic equipment, and control systems, scientific devices, instrumentation and precision equipment.

skills.label: operating aircraft
skills.description: Controlling the movement of aircraft, including fixed wing aircraft, helicopters and drones.
